# flaggr_environment (Data Source)

Look up a Flaggr project environment by project ID and slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flaggr_environment" "production" {
  project_id = data.flaggr_project.platform.id
  slug       = "production"
}

output "production_requires_approval" {
  value = data.flaggr_environment.production.require_approval
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Hex color.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Environment description.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a default environment.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `order` (Number) Pipeline order.
- `protected_environment` (Boolean) Whether this is a protected environment.
- `require_approval` (Boolean) Whether promotions require approval.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
